title: Mode Situation
description: WO-049 (Issue #92) item 5, design in Issue #91 comment 2 (WO-048 design part 2) Section 3.3. 'What is happening now, according to source-backed Developments', in a five-value vocabulary, for one (mode, geography) pair. Computed deterministically -- Gate 0 plus five ordered rules, analysis/situations.py::compute_mode_situation -- from already-approved logistics_event/claim/document records; never authored directly by AI or a human. Consumes the existing nine-area impact_assessment machinery; does not recompute it. Written to data/situations/situations.json in the existing data/events/-style single-combined-file layout.

situation_id.description: Derived from (mode, geography_id, as_of): SIT-<MODE>-<GEOGRAPHY>-<as_of as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.

as_of.description: Build time -- when this record was computed.

evidence_cutoff_at.description: The newest published_at among contributing Documents, or as_of if no event contributed. Distinct from as_of on purpose: a build run this morning over evidence current only to last night must say so.

status.description: Design part 2 Section 3.5's five ordered rules, first match wins. No averaging, no weighting, no count-based dilution.

status_basis.description: Non-empty for every status except 'insufficient_current_evidence' -- enforced in scripts/validate.py, not this schema (an empty array is structurally legal so an 'insufficient_current_evidence' record, which has nothing to cite, still validates).

confidence.description: Reuses the one confidence scale already on claim.schema.json and impact_assessment.schema.json.

confidence_reductions.description: Every reason confidence was reduced from the leading contributing event's own confidence, named explicitly. A confidence with no stated basis is not publishable -- the same discipline as logistics_event.active_basis. May be empty only when confidence was not reduced from its starting point.

contributing_event_ids.description: Events that passed Gate 0 and actually drove the status.

watch_event_ids.description: Events that passed Gate 0 but did not drive the status (e.g. below the leading rule's threshold).

excluded_event_ids.description: Every event Gate 0 rejected, with its reason -- what makes the assessment explainable in the negative direction. is_active_at's own human-readable ActivityDecision.reason strings are reused directly.

state.description: The OLDEST contributor governs the state -- a stale contributor must be visible, not averaged away.

gaps.description: Capability-registry gap identifiers relevant to this situation. Deliberately not computed by this Work Order (WO-045's #ocean-major-gaps derivation is a Dashboard-facing mechanism this Work Order does not touch); always an empty array today -- see docs/situation_synthesis.md.

window_minutes.description: min(max_stale_minutes) over sources_with_public_claims, or null when the set is empty.

coverage_basis.description: The input to rule 4's coverage minimum (design part 2 Section 3.5).

dataset.description: A mode_situation record exists only on the current surface.
